prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Deep Orbit cinematic cel-shaded narrative,1536x1024 landscape. First portraits establish fixed canonical identities, facial morphology and age, eyes/nose/jaw, hair, costume and equipment. Next approved room master for ROOM ARCHITECTURE ONLY, not diagrams or colors. Last reference exact restaging target. Restrained clean outlines and muted sage #6BAA8A, aged brass #A89060, charcoal/navy, natural skin, modest practical lights. No glossy or neon lime. Balanced stylized adults with coherent neck/shoulders/torso, plausible arm chains, exactly two five-finger hands each, natural chair/table support. Faces visible, eyes follow work or other crew, candid action and subtle lively emotion, no camera gaze or presentation portrait. Screens physically face actual reader; camera beside reader sees same front face. Every label, cell, line, arrow follows correct surface perspective. Remove outward handheld displays. Peripheral screens inactive. Only specified content, no fake numerical findings or extra diagrams. Farah seated LEFT at bridge console inspecting forecasting plan, one hand turning a physical dial and other resting on console. She leans forward slightly with curious thoughtful smile at display RIGHT, face in threequarter profile. Remove tablet and stylus. Display heading "Rolling forecast". Four connected boxes arranged logically left-to-right: "Recent window", "Predict", "Clamp", "Append". A return arrow from Append back to Recent window. Beneath "Reuse saved scaling", then "Check errors against later readings". Smaller note "Compare with last-value baseline". Draw arrows and text in exact monitor plane. No invented waveform or forecast result. The tangible dial selects the loop inspection, all screen content is lesson-specific. Warm muted bridge setting with dark stars.
meaning: Multi-step forecast uses recentwindow,predict,clamp in savedzscoreunits,append andfeed back; evaluate laterreadings andlastvaluebaseline.
